videos.visual_summary: A speaker illuminated by a spotlight gestures while giving a presentation to a seated audience inside a large industrial venue.
Audience members sit attentively in a dimly lit auditorium, while a young woman uses her illuminated smartphone to record the ongoing event.
In a crowded exhibition hall, a presenter demonstrates trail running shoes to a group of attendees at a trade show booth as one customer picks up a shoe to examine it.
Under a bright desk lamp, a person's hands hold and rotate a dark trail running shoe to display its upper design and treaded rubber sole.
A smiling man in a suit stands at a podium inside a crowded auditorium while a large seated audience applauds him in a triumphant atmosphere.
In a modern high-rise room with large floor-to-ceiling windows, a group of professionals in business attire socialize, chat, and drink coffee together during a daytime gathering.
In a spacious event hall, staff members neatly arrange trail running shoes, apparel, and athletic gear along long white display tables.
A man presents a blue and grey running sneaker to an audience in a professional indoor setting, speaking enthusiastically.
At a trade show display, a person inspects a black running hydration vest with a built-in light mounted on a pegboard wall and takes it off its hook.
Professionals wearing lanyards talk, check their phones, and stand in a long line inside a brightly lit conference hallway with large glass windows.
At a busy trade show, a representative helps a smiling woman adjust and turn on a headlamp while her companion laughs and gives a thumbs-up.
